draft.subject: Re: Bulk import — and getting Pioneer Media's first project up
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for flagging the bulk invite question — you're right that one-by-one wouldn't scale for your size. As Tariq confirmed, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and I'll keep your ticket open until you're happy it's sorted.

On the Wrenfield side, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the thing that makes everything else click.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your first project and the CSV invite together.

Best,
Nadia
